decision: Stage 1 = research + two script versions + storyboard + voice test only; no animation or video render
why: Owner approval of the story and voice style comes before spending render time; another agent is rendering, so CPU stays light

decision: On-screen numbers limited to ~8 CM spacing, 4+ markers in view, 3+ matching points per piece
why: Only these are SOURCED in research.md from makers' docs/tutorials and university guides; marker counts and times for a whole car are UNSOURCED and sources disagree

decision: No time figure for the usual way; the wall clock has no numerals
why: Vendor case studies range 1.5 h to overnight and none is neutral; a spinning clock says 'long' without inventing a number

decision: Part B shows no 32/20 minute figures and no 'no stitching' claim; NO MARKERS and 'minutes, not hours' left as owner options
why: Owner asked R3 not to give away the real time; whether the IS350 scan needed alignment is not documented; no-markers comes from the brief and the R2 footage shows no dots, but no project note states it

decision: Scanner not named anywhere in the script
why: Host says Artec Leo on camera (speedrun transcript) but brands are owner-only in the long-form, and the reel must not name scanner brands

decision: Part B reuses V_PAIR_2, V_PAIR_3, V_MATCH_FRONT, V_RES_FULL (clean renders, not R1-R3 mp4 frames); V_MATCH_REAR is the spare
why: All exist and are verified; V_MATCH_REAR's lower 40 % is black and reads badly right after a full-frame cartoon; R2's V_RES_FULL carries the 32 MIN line baked in

decision: Voices: kristin (PIP), john (GUS), joe (SCANNER); norman, lessac-derived, ryan and hfc rejected
why: Model cards: kristin/john public domain, joe CC0 (base CC0); lessac Blizzard licence is per-licensee, ryan/hfc CC BY-NC-SA; norman babbled 6-8 s of noise on 4-word lines

decision: Version B line 1 changed from 'Quick!' to 'Hurry!'
why: faster-whisper heard the squeaky 'Quick!' as 'Click.' (WER 0.25); 'Hurry!' transcribed exactly (WER 0.00)

decision: Recommend Blender 5.3 Cycles CPU flat toon look (inverted-hull outlines, 4-8 spp, persistent data off) + Remotion text overlay; estimate 25-45 min render for 465 frames, untested
why: True cuboid characters with perspective camera moves match the block-style ask; Eevee/Workbench need OpenGL that this GPU-less container has not been checked for; Remotion-only is faster but reads as flat 2D

decision: Voices move to Higgsfield seed_audio presets (samples: Pixie, Benji +3, Mabel +2 for Pip; Bram -2, Barrett -3, Gideon for Gus), only mild pitch shifts
why: Owner: the free-engine samples all sound super weird; heavy pitch/formant shifting was the likely cause

decision: Go with script A; NO MARKERS text left out until the owner confirms it; cartoon world uses the site palette (#0b0c0b, #619f73, #ecefec)
why: Owner picked A; no project note confirms markerless scanning; owner asked for Illumaesthetic colours on R3

decision: Part A look: brand palette (near-black outlines and GUS coveralls, sage cap/band/scanner light, light-sage PIP hoodie, off-white dots/eyes), car blue #2a4fb5, warm neutral shop; red only on the clock second hand
why: Owner asked for the illumaesthetic.com colours; red reserved for the pain beat so it reads

decision: Toon look = Cycles diffuse-only + bright warm world + one soft sun, Standard view transform, inverted-hull outlines whose shell is transparent to non-camera rays
why: Standard keeps brand hexes as authored; first hull test shaded every object black because the shell blocked shadow and ambient rays

decision: Characters: bevelled cuboid bodies with round disc eyes, block lids/brows/mouth; PIP small with big head and hair tuft, GUS 2.1 m with tiny head, half lids, sage cap
why: Block-style per the brief but our own design: round eyes and toy-block bevels keep them away from any existing game's square pixel faces

decision: Marker dots placed by Poisson-disc sampling, 7 cm minimum spacing (typical neighbour ~8 cm), off glass/lights/arches
why: Matches the sourced ~8 CM and RANDOM, NEVER IN ROWS text on screen; 934 dots on the car

decision: S5 staged in profile instead of over GUS's shoulder; cone radius solved so exactly 4 dot centres are lit
why: Over-the-shoulder drafts hid the cone behind GUS's back at phone size; 4 lit dots matches SCANNER NEEDS 4+ DOTS IN VIEW

decision: S4 camera ~29 deg off vertical instead of 12
why: From 12 deg GUS read as a dark blob; the higher tilt keeps the car's length up the frame and GUS readable

decision: S6 shows front, side and roof as translucent grey scan pieces lifted off the blue car in their own directions, rear left uncaptured, high camera
why: Grey patches sitting on the car read as a grey car; lifted pieces read as 'in pieces' and the high angle uses the vertical frame

decision: Laptop pins colour-coded (sage/off-white/blue), not numbered; clock has ticks only
why: Only the sourced numbers (~8 CM, 4+, 3+) may appear on screen

decision: Talk animation keyed from script line windows and later word timings, not audio RMS
why: Voices not cast yet; windows get replaced by measured silencedetect/whisper timings when takes exist

decision: Stage 1 look dev: 10 stills at 1080x1920 8 spp + 465-frame animatic (stills held, script A subtitles, title placeholders, silent audio); S5 camera pushed in, S4 clock inset top-left
why: Phone-size (360 px) check: S5 cone and lit dots were too small to read in a second; the inset covered GUS in S4

decision: Ending rewritten: Pip saw an Illumaesthetic video that did it way faster; real IS350 footage enters on Pip's phone screen, push into the screen, ends on reel 3's tease card and logo; Gus VO over real footage dropped
why: Owner suggestion; the phone makes the reel point at the IS350 video instead of only following the cartoon

decision: Cast reframed as father (Gus) and child (Pip); samples: kids Kiki/Pixie/Lucy pitched +4/+5, dads Bob/Brooks unshifted (Grady still queued)
why: Owner: make the voices like a father and child; no child preset exists, so light female presets with a modest pitch lift

decision: Revised ending S10-S12 (S10 423-459, S11 459-498, S12 498-519); Part A ends at 17.3 s
why: Owner's new ending: PIP saw an Illumaesthetic video; the phone hands over to the real IS350 footage

decision: Phone screen = flat #ff00ff emission seen by the camera only (no diffuse/glossy/shadow visibility), corners per frame in screen_corners.json (tl,tr,br,bl px, origin top-left)
why: Magenta appears nowhere else; no light spill means the key and the corner-pin stay clean; the compositor gets corners plus a key matte for anything in front

decision: S11 camera parallel to the screen normal, shifted sideways; S12 push on the screen axis, lens 35, 1.6 m to 0.2644 m (screen height = frame height), exponential distance with k^1.4 ease-in
why: Screen stays an upright 9:16 rectangle, so the corner-pin is exact and S12's last frame (518) equals the full 1080x1920 frame: real 9:16 footage cuts in with no crop change (checked: S12end render key colour everywhere except the 1 px border)

decision: PIP's arm aimed at a point beside and in front of his face, phone placed 0.14 m in front of his hand; GUS in S12 peeks in from the right in profile, head beside the screen, body behind its plane
why: Earlier drafts put PIP's head, PIP's hand, and GUS's body and arm between camera and screen; this staging keeps everything out of the camera-to-screen cone during the push

decision: Animatic uses P2's first frame from the clean graded intermediate (R1_SCAN.mov at 322.0 s, x0 600 scaled to 1067 in 3414x1920, 1080x1920 crop), corner-pinned and keyed; S12 shown as a 2D zoom of its start still driven by the corner JSON; 1 s P2 tail added
why: Owner judges the hand-off; spans.json x0 is in 1920x1080 coords; a still frame stands in for the moving footage

decision: S9 pile: peeled dots as white stickers (thin ring, big white face, a third face-down plain white); S7 laptop: side-view car of rear quarter, roof, front bumper/fender with headlight, wheels; the DOOR (window, handle) is dragged with 3 colour pin pairs
why: Owner-side weak points from stage 1: grey/black pile, abstract jigsaw shapes

decision: Cast locked: Pip = Higgsfield Kiki (+4 pitch, +15 rate), Gus = Bob (+10 rate); all 13 lines generated, 2 takes each, in /home/user/media/work/scan-tedium/voice/takes
why: Owner picked Kiki and Bob from the father/child samples; two takes per line to pick the cleanest

decision: Takes: L01b L02a L03d L04b L05a L06b L07b L08b L09a L10a L11a L12a L13b
why: Exact words in every pick (whisper WER 0); shorter wins ties; L04a/L08a/L13a avoided (wrong or clipped words), L09b a clipped 0.23 s No at p 0.65, L03c has a 0.45 s hole, L11a per coordinator until the owner confirms the brand name

decision: Takes trimmed to speech, inner pauses cut to <= 0.18 s (0.26-0.28 s for So..., Front. Side. Roof. Back., Wait.), rubberband tempo 1.0-1.12 with pitch and formants kept
why: Raw takes sum to ~23 s of speech alone; owner allows up to 1.12 speed-up and wants Part A about 22 s; re-transcription of every processed clip still exact (L11 brand name as in the source take)

decision: Speech start from energy runs, word times from faster-whisper word_timestamps mapped through the cuts and tempo
why: faster-whisper pins every take's first word to 0.0 s; energy at -40 dB missed pauses with room tone, so pause candidates also come from whisper word gaps

decision: Part A re-timed to the voices: 669 frames = 22.30 s; shots cut on a short lead/tail around each line
why: Re-timing keeps every line at natural speed; the cartoon beats (slaps, lift, snap, push) get small extras

decision: Dialogue stem: lines level-matched, float mix, two-pass loudnorm to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP
why: First int16 mix clipped (+4 dBFS peaks) and came out at -22 LUFS

decision: Animation is procedural per frame from partA_timeline.json, rendered as resumable stills (tmp+rename), per-shot ProRes 422 after a black/unlit check, PNGs deleted
why: Disk is tight; lessons: Cycles can drop lights mid-sequence, so every frame's luma is checked against its shot

decision: S12: GUS crouched 0.22 m, leans 20->55 deg with his head counter-tilted (face upright, profile), head beside the screen cone
why: Draft showed only his back/chin at the top edge; now cap, eye and mouth read while nothing enters the camera-to-screen cone

decision: S3: slaps limited to dots inside the visible door area
why: First draft put the new dots and hand off the right edge of frame

decision: Phone footage = FX30541 leading into P2 (322.0 s) frame-exact: R1_SCAN.mov for source frames >= 7708, 1080p proxy with the same LUT before that
why: The 4K-graded intermediate has only a 0.5 s handle before P2; the proxy aligns frame-exact (MAD 1.8 levels at offset 0 vs 12+ at +-1) and is only small on screen there

decision: No wall-clock inset in S4
why: One idea per shot: S4 is dots spreading; the clock gag is S8

decision: Paused Part A Blender render; exploring new 3D character set on Higgsfield (Thing-Thing / Madness Combat homage, family-friendly, brand palette)
why: Owner asked to stop and pick a recurring Illumaesthetic character look before animating further; homage in build (capsule bodies, egg heads, crosshair face, floating hands) with own outfits so it isn't a copy

decision: Cartoon world switched to cel-shaded EEVEE toon (outlines, 2-3 bands)
why: Owner: match the art style so the whole world stays cel-shaded; also closer to the Flash homage, stronger contrast at the cut to real footage, and renders in seconds/frame instead of 11-33 s on Cycles CPU

decision: Owner look change: cel-shaded EEVEE (Shader to RGB -> constant 3-band ramp -> emission), black inverted-hull outlines (back-face culled, transparent to shadow rays), grey desaturated shop, sage accents kept
why: Owner direction 2026-11-14 plus cel_ref.png; band edges calibrated to the lit-luminance range (~0.45 ambient to 1.15 facing the sun): shadow < 0.60, highlight > 1.08 (heads and hands only)

decision: EEVEE runs headless on Mesa llvmpipe through EGL after installing libegl1, libegl-mesa0 and libgbm1 (apt); no GPU
why: EEVEE failed with no libEGL; software GL is ~0.7 s per render sample per frame for a trivial scene

decision: Key light moved to front-left-above (camera side)
why: Side/back light split every head into lit and dark halves; the reference reads mostly lit with a narrow shadow side

decision: Characters rebuilt to the locked turnarounds: egg heads, pill bodies, two dot eyes only, no arms/shoulders, mitten hands floating about a hand-width out, stubby dark feet, straight-tube vest/hoodie; Gus 1.97 m with goggles, Pip 1.19 m with cap (60 %)
why: characters/design.md + coordinator; design.md says about half, the coordinator 60 % - used 60 %

decision: Rig keeps the old pivot names (arms/elbows/hands are invisible pivots placing the floating hands), so the stage-3 animation drives the new characters
why: No re-animation needed; aim_arm, attach and the phone pose work unchanged

decision: No mouths: talk energy from the word times squashes/stretches the body (torso only) and lifts the hands; dot eyes blink and squint on the stressed word
why: Owner: no mouth; the torso-only squash keeps the phone hand fixed so S11's screen corners stay static

decision: Pip carries his small sage-grip scanner in his free hand; LEDs light sage, not bright green
why: Character design; palette is greyscale plus sage only

decision: Lookdev timing at 1080x1920: 12.5-14.6 s/frame at 8 samples, 7.5-7.7 s at 4 samples
why: Full Part A (669 frames) would be ~2.6 h at 8 or ~1.4 h at 4 samples on software GL; 4 samples looked nearly identical at 1:1

decision: Head/body: egg flipped (widest at the top), heads 1.55x (Gus) / 1.65x (Pip) the body pill, seated on the collar with an outline break
why: Coordinator: head and body read as one worm-like pill

decision: Toon band edges from a measured luminance pass (--lumdebug): lit range ~0.27-0.82, shadow < 0.33 (shadow colour 0.82 x base), highlight > 0.77
why: Head shadow read as a hood/hair; now a thin light crescent and a small highlight

decision: Car muted steel blue #5d718a; clock hand, sweep and pin sage; laptop window dot grey
why: Owner palette: greyscale + sage; red was outside it

decision: Pip's cap opening = plain dark band, no holes or arch
why: Holes read as a second pair of eyes above his real ones

decision: Pip's scanner in hand only in S1, pouch elsewhere, hidden in S10-S12
why: Coordinator: only while scanning or gesturing about scanning; never in the phone shots

decision: S12 Gus leans in beside the phone just behind the screen plane; S10 phone hand aimed in front of Pip's chest; S6 scan pieces flat emission with blended alpha
why: Draft: the new bigger head blocked the screen, the phone was off-frame, dithered alpha speckled

decision: partA_v1.mp4 delivered: 669 frames (22.30 s), EEVEE cel look at 4 samples, IS350 footage corner-pinned and keyed into the phone, full-frame on frame 668
why: Owner-approved look and staging; after the container restart only S9's missing 25 frames and S10-S12 were rendered (S1-S8 and 27 S9 frames survived)

decision: Re-added PIP 'There has to be a better way.' (L10Ba, x1.12) in S10 before 'Wait.', 0.35 s beat; Part A 730 frames = 24.33 s
why: Owner v1 note; L10Ba exact (WER 0) and 1.4 s shorter than L10Bb ('Ugh...'); extending S10 keeps one shot for the deflate-then-perk beat

decision: Voice polish per line: HP 90 Hz, +3 dB @ 3.5 kHz, +2 dB shelf @ 9 kHz, 3:1 comp; stem -14 LUFS / TP <= -1 dBTP (measured -14.2 LUFS, -4.0 dBTP, LRA 3.2)
why: Owner: voices too muted and dull; music goes under later so the voice must sit on top; every processed line still transcribes exactly

decision: Gus's vest reaches the head: vest tube to 6 cm under the neck, thick collar ring meeting the head, body pill ends under the head
why: Owner: grey band between collar and head

decision: Mouthless talk stronger: body squash 12 %, hand lifts 75/45 deg x energy, head bob 7 deg x energy, accents x1.8
why: Coordinator: 7 % barely read in a 1 s strip; phone hand stays fixed (aimed after the pose; squash is torso-only)

decision: S3 reused from v1; all other shots re-rendered
why: S3 shows no vest and no talking; S10-S12 shift by 61 frames, corners recomputed

decision: partA_v2.mp4 delivered: 730 frames (24.33 s), dialogue -14.2 LUFS / -3.9 dBTP muxed, phone full-frame on 729, P2 at 730
why: Owner v1 notes applied in one pass; S3 reused, S1-S2 and S4-S12 re-rendered

decision: Switch Part A voices to ElevenLabs v4 dialogue, Kiki (Pip) + Harrison (Gus), no speed-ups
why: Owner found Seed Audio voices weird; picked pair B from a 2-pair test
